import React from 'react';
import { Box, Typography, Card, CardContent, Button, Stack, AppBar } from '@mui/material';
import MinimalAppBar from '../../Component/MinimalAppBar';

const LoanScreen = () => {
  return (
    <>
        <MinimalAppBar onBack={()=>window.history.back} title="สินเชื่อของฉัน"></MinimalAppBar>
        <Box p={3} bgcolor="background.primary">
      {/* <Box
        sx={{
          p: 1.2,
          marginY: 1,
          borderRadius: 2,
          border: '2px solid #004d40',
          boxShadow: '0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,0.1)',
          color: 'primary',
          textAlign: 'center',
        }}
      >
        <Typography variant="h6" fontWeight="bold">
          
        </Typography>
      </Box> */}
      {/* สรุปสินเชื่อ */}
<Box
  sx={{
    display: 'flex',
    overflowX: 'auto',
    gap: 2,
    padding: 2,
    scrollSnapType: 'x mandatory',
    '&::-webkit-scrollbar': { display: 'none' }, // ซ่อน scrollbar
  }}
>
  {contracts.map((contract, index) => (
    <Card
      key={index}
      sx={{
        minWidth: 300,
        flexShrink: 0,
        scrollSnapAlign: 'start',
        mb: 3,
      }}
    >
      <CardContent
        sx={{
          background: 'linear-gradient(135deg, #c8d60cff 0%, #b915b1ff 50%, #d80adfff 100%)',
          padding: 4,
          borderRadius: 0,
          color: '#FFFFFF',
          fontFamily: 'Prompt, sans-serif',
        }}
      >
        <Stack spacing={1}>
          <Typography variant="subtitle1">เลขที่สัญญา : {contract.id}</Typography>
          <Typography variant="subtitle1">ยอดคงเหลือ</Typography>
          <Typography variant="h4" color="light">฿{contract.balance}</Typography>

          <Box display="flex" justifyContent="space-between">
            <Box>
              <Typography variant="subtitle2">เงินดาวน์</Typography>
              <Typography>฿{contract.downPayment}</Typography>
            </Box>
            <Box>
              <Typography variant="subtitle2">ยอดผ่อน/เดือน</Typography>
              <Typography>฿{contract.monthly}</Typography>
            </Box>
          </Box>
        </Stack>
      </CardContent>
    </Card>
  ))}
</Box>


      {/* ประวัติการชำระเงิน */}
      <Typography variant="h6" gutterBottom>ประวัติการชำระเงิน</Typography>
      <Card sx={{ mb: 3 }}>
        <CardContent>
          <Stack spacing={1}>
            <Box display="flex" justifyContent="space-between">
              <Typography>ส.ค. 2025</Typography>
              <Typography color="primary">ชำระแล้ว ฿5,000</Typography>
            </Box>
            <Box display="flex" justifyContent="space-between">
              <Typography>ก.ค. 2025</Typography>
              <Typography color="primary">ชำระแล้ว ฿5,000</Typography>
            </Box>
          </Stack>
        </CardContent>
      </Card>

      {/* เมนูการดำเนินการ */}
      <Stack direction="row" spacing={2}>
        <Button fullWidth variant="contained" color="primary">ขอเพิ่มวงเงิน</Button>
        <Button fullWidth variant="outlined" color="primary">ดูรายละเอียดสัญญา</Button>
      </Stack>
    </Box>
    </>
  );
};

export default LoanScreen;
